description: Linéaire d'aménagements cyclables en Pays de la Loire is a dataset listed in data.teo-paysdelaloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ecolab. Ce jeu de données diffuse le linéaire d'aménagements cyclables, de 2022 à 2025, au 1er janvier de chaque année. Ce linéaire a été calculé par Ecolab à partir du suivi des aménagements cyclables effectués par GéoVélo et que nous pouvons aussi retrouver sur l'opendata de TEO. Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are TEO, Energie-Climat, Mobilité. The portal shows 34,384 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-12-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-teo-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
